doc: Image accuracy baselines and their exceptions (ADR 0047, ADR 0052). Measured by tools/bench/compare_direct.py --final [--sky] at 640x360 against the path tracer. A scene passes at flip + max(0.001, 5% of flip) mean FLIP and within 2% mean luminance, unless an exception names an open backlog item: tools/scripts/check_repo.py fails once that item is done, so the exception goes with its bug. 'gate': the pre-push gate runs it (tests/CMakeLists.txt); 'benchmark': run by hand in a release build when lighting, the denoiser or the upscaler changes.
